title: Mind Control & The Power Of Prayer

sense.text:
We think we have free will in this life: we do what we want, we answer to nobody, we make our own decisions. But every decision we make, and every decision we ever made, has been filtered through something or somebody. Being in this truth we have to understand that either we are doing the work of the Lord or we are doing the work of Satan. We can’t play both.

“The things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God.” Paul was saying it at the time, but it is the Lord saying it: “I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.”

“Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils.” You can’t be lukewarm. You have to pick a side. Either you are doing the will and the work of the Lord, or you are doing the will and the work of Satan, and that is what it all comes back to: we are being controlled either by the heavenly Father or by Satan himself. That is the mind control at work in our lives.

Where is the dark mind control coming from? It was laid out in the letter of Willie Lynch, the breaking process: break the man in front of the woman, bull whip him to the point of death, and leave her unprotected, so that she raises her son to be mentally weak and physically strong and her daughter to be independent. The white man put his thoughts in her mind. That is where the ‘independent’ songs come from, and why so many of our women think they don’t need a man. Then came the women’s liberation movement thrown into the civil rights movement, turning it into woman against man, and the welfare system that told our women to put the man out of the house to feed their children, when the white farm wife was never told to get rid of the farmer. We always thrived together, at Black Wall Street in North Carolina and in Tulsa, and fought together in the 60s, until the white man put his thoughts back in her head. And he put the thought in the black man’s head that we are low down, bums, nothing, never showing anything good about us, to keep us under bondage while white supremacy keeps control.

That is mind control: the manipulation of a person’s thoughts and beliefs to serve the interests of the manipulator, by gaslighting, isolation (keeping the black man and the black woman apart, so the home stays broken and the kids end up dead or in jail), and wearing down critical thinking. It creates a distorted reality. We keep looking for something good and nothing comes: hoping our community gets better, hoping for better jobs, hoping things get better, and it doesn’t happen. They do it in a lot of different ways: voting, religion, the music, entertainment. They tell us we can be basketball players and football players, but a very low percentage of our people make it, and the ones who do can’t help their people. Then you get the stereotypes: no Cosby household anymore with a doctor and a lawyer and a strong home, only drug dealers, gangs and actors playing transsexuals. It leaves lasting trauma, the PTSD we carry from slavery, Jim Crow and the black codes, that we never fully recovered from. Our freedom comes back through this Bible, and through gathering together and building our government, different offices in the body (like the stewardship program and hope and healing) to bring us back together.

And here is the source: “the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world.” He deceived the world through his witchcraft. One way he deceived the world: he gave us a white image of Jesus Christ, which is nowhere in the Bible, a white God touching the finger of a white Adam. Adam was white? What, white dirt? Moses white, the apostles white, everybody white. That is how he deceived the world. “He was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.”

“Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you.” Who did Satan come down to? To us. He came down to try us, “having great wrath”: he is mad as hell because we are the children of God. “Because he knoweth that he hath but a short time”: he knows he doesn’t have long, which is why the Most High had to shorten the days for the elect.

So right now Satan is running around angry, manipulating people through his witchcraft and his lies, feeding the people his lies. Television is a part of that witchcraft. Even the people who make it confess it is not the truth: an amusement park, a circus, illusions, they will tell you anything you want to hear, and the people dress like the tube, eat like the tube, raise their children like the tube and think like the tube. Esau will tell you the truth right in your face and we don’t pick up on it. We sit in front of the TV and the game console. When we were coming up the TV went off at midnight; now they have to program you around the clock with their witchcraft, and that is why evil has grown worse and worse in the earth.

precepts.why:
Satan came down knowing he has but a short time. So what is he going to do in that short time? Bring righteousness? Bring love? Build up the twelve tribes of Israel? No. He is trying to break us. He is getting his two thirds together, while Christ and the angels are getting the one third together.

“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof.” That is why we are on one side of the coin or the other. Anything we are getting out of this earth right now is evil. Anything outside of this Bible is evil: nothing in it will make us more productive, wake us up, bring us back to the heavenly Father, to keeping his high holy days and his laws and commandments, or give us back our nationality. The earth is in the hands of the wicked, the demonic beings on this earth.

So we have to be the ones who stand up and fight against it. We have to fix our minds on this Bible, meditate day and night, learn who we are and the prophecies to come, and learn how to wake our people up. Satan has a job to do, and he is gathering his people together slowly but surely; you see people falling out the door, going back to the world, feeling they are missing something.

TV is one of the main distractions to throw our people off, and it is not by coincidence: the Jewish corporations own 96% of the media by their own count, and more like 99%. The earth is given into the hands of the wicked, and the wicked are the ones Satan is using.

sense.text:
Who is Satan using? The wicked, his children. “For such are false apostles, deceitful workers.” They have a job to do. Their job is to get in your brain and make you feel like you are nothing, make you think less of yourself, control your mind and get you out there with him.

“Transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.” They transform themselves to look righteous. The ones who call themselves Jewish act like righteous, God-fearing people, but they don’t give a damn about the Most High or this Bible. They read the Talmud, and there is a lot of evil in that book. They are not with this Bible.
“And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.” Satan acts like he is righteous, acts like he is good.

“Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness.” His ministers, his workers, are the same: they look and act righteous, act like Christians, act Jewish, act like they love God, but it is all a facade to destroy us and lead us straight to the gates of hell. The newspapers and the TV stations are behind it all. That is their witchcraft to destroy our minds.

Satan transformed himself into an angel of light, so we have to beware and be focused: these men are out here to destroy us. How do they destroy you? By getting your mind. Making you think you are not worthy, you are nothing, you haven’t been called, maybe it was a mistake. As soon as people go through something and get to their lowest point, they want to run and play the victim: ‘y’all keep correcting me, I can’t do nothing right.’ That is Satan in their mind, controlling them to think that way. We have to become more rooted and grounded in this truth, and our faith has to increase in these last days, because there are too many distractions out here pulling you back into the world.

“Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ.”

“Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world.” That is what Christ came for. It was bad back then; now it is a hundred times worse, and he is delivering us out of it, “according to the will of God and our Father.”

Why does he have to deliver us? Because everything around us is evil. Everything they set up is against us and set up to destroy us, and they start with your mind. They get in your head and make you think you are nothing, make you go against your own brother and hate your own brother. Look at the other camps out here: all the work that needs to be done, all the places in the world to cover, and they sit chasing us around. That is Satan in their mind.

“That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.” They shoot at us and fear not.

“They encourage themselves in an evil matter”: they encourage themselves to do evil against us. “They commune of laying snares privily”: they lay traps for us. Social media is a trap. The music is a trap. Politics is a trap. These fake holidays are traps. Next week a whole bunch of people will celebrate Thanksgiving, with turkey and cranberry sauce. Where do you read that in the Bible? For Passover he told us what to eat: lamb, bitter herbs and unleavened bread.

“They say, Who shall see them?” Nobody sees us laying traps. Nobody sees us putting all these guns in Chicago, all these drugs in Philadelphia, all this on the West Coast.

“They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search”: they accomplish what they are looking for. “Both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.” We are thinking about tomorrow; they are thinking about a hundred years from now. How can we destroy this whole generation, Generation Z? Music. Social media: let them fight each other and beat each other down. The school-to-prison pipeline.
“But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.” God is going to shoot back at them.

“So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves.” How do you think we are finding out about all the evil they are doing, all the snares and traps they set up? Their own tongue. They will even tell you your own mind is rigged against you: every decision filtered through a bias, the brain seeking comfort and not truth, scrolling and following whatever tells you that you are right. They already fed your mind so much garbage that you believe it: the same thing on ten, fifteen TV shows, fake news and propaganda, and our minds rigged to believe whatever they put out. We have this Bible and we can filter truth. But a lot of people don’t want truth, they want to be comfortable: ‘I’m just doing Thanksgiving for the family,’ ‘Christmas is just for the kids.’ You can buy them presents any time. They love lies. We are going out to speak truth, and no propaganda, fake news, social media or TV is going to stop us doing the work of the Lord or separate us from the love of God.

“All that see them shall flee away.” They are going to see the man of sin and the wickedness he has been doing. Israel blew a whole area off the map and nobody says anything. Where are the pastors and the preachers? They won’t speak truth, because their minds are wired, they have the white man’s brain in their body, and they don’t want to lose their position, their money, their prestige. We don’t care; we will talk about the evil being done over there, even though the Palestinians and the Arabs are evil too, for they had us in the Arab slave trade and did the same and worse to us. The Most High is saying we are the ones who will stand up and fight against all this evil, and our minds will not be wired to this system.

That white image of Christ is a part of their witchcraft. Ask little kids, grown people, old people. A man is shown a white Jesus and a black Jesus and he chooses the white one: he can’t go with the black Jesus because black people have more struggle than any people on the planet, the white one isn’t racist, the white one was there before the black one. See how destroyed we are? The white image is Cesare Borgia, a murderer who had a baby by his own sister Lucrezia, a homosexual, all type of evil, and the man choosing him has been seared with a hot iron to believe in that white image; he loves it. He even says the black man in himself is God, and still chooses the white Jesus. Our people are destroyed for a lack of knowledge. Our brains are melted; we have PTSD. Thank God for this truth, because without it we would be just like him, loving a white image and saying there is no black image.

“His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow.” Christ’s hair was white like wool: woolly texture. “And his eyes were as a flame of fire”: his eyes were red, because he drank wine, as Genesis 49 shows.

“And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace.” His feet were dark, so dark they looked like they burned in a furnace. This is in the Bible. So how can anyone say the white image was before him?

So why are all these atrocities happening to the blacks, our Latinos and the Native American Indians? “If thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee.” All these curses came upon us and overtook us.

“Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.” We are a cursed people, because we broke God’s laws and commandments. Just like in your house: if you set up rules and somebody breaks them, you punish them. We are the children of God; we broke his rules, and we are being punished right now for breaking his law and commandments.

“Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel”: prophesying against the so-called pastors, the so-called leaders of Israel. “Prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God unto the shepherds”: we have to say thus saith the Lord God, and speak as the oracles of God.

“Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves!” Destruction to the shepherds feeding themselves. “Should not the shepherds feed the flocks?” The shepherds are supposed to be feeding the flock. Instead you have the Northern Kingdom throwing the Bible on the floor, and a man falling out because he couldn’t pass the Bible: terrible acting. That is mind control. Satan is working in them. Not just the heathen, the other nations: our own people are playing games with God.

That is why so much evil is going on: kids beating each other down, shooting each other, robbing each other as a people. We haven’t fixed ourselves yet, and the churches are playing games, not teaching our people the law and the commandments. Christianity is a major problem in our communities: all these churches and nobody changing. They chased the kids out of the church, and now the kids run up and down the block killing each other with no direction. The blame for this goes on the Christian church.

precepts.why:
“His watchmen are blind”: these pastors running around are blind. “They are all ignorant”: they don’t know the Bible, so they are in there doing stupidness like throwing the Bible on the floor and shaking and falling down for no reason. That is evilness.

“They are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark.” They cannot preach the Bible. They cannot teach our people how to get themselves together, cannot bring our people back to Christ, the black Messiah, cannot teach our people that they must keep the law and commandments. “Sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.” The lying down is literal: lying down with everybody in the church, the men, the women and the kids. We are living in an evil time.

“Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough.” Look at the seed offerings: a little boy who thinks he is doing the right thing, who wants to be fed the word of God and grow up to be a servant of the Lord, told to sow a seed of $1,000, then ‘a thousand plus a thousand,’ by a man in a suit that cost $5,000 or more. He walked away broken. They are breaking the people. Another wears a diamond-encrusted watch worth $80,000 to $100,000 and a bracelet worth thousands, and tells the ushers to close the doors, with the men standing behind him ready to shake somebody down, charging the people on the stage a hundred and the people in the seats a thousand. People go in there to serve God and he locks the doors. Take the watch off: you have the money you are looking for right there. Did you hear them say anything about Israel? About the killing? Where are the big-time pastors when people are being shot down in the streets? They are not for the people. The people out there in those churches are being controlled by religion, by lies and deceit, by a demonic spirit, and they haven’t learned it yet.

“And they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.” Every one for his gain: a thousand, ten thousand, twenty thousand, fifty thousand. They all say the same thing, regurgitating the same thing, because it comes from the same person: Satan. He is in their mind, controlling them. That is why the people who come to talk to us on Clubhouse and in the streets all come with the same handful of verses, the same rhetoric over and over: they are not being taught, so they don’t know the Bible.

They are greedy dogs; they don’t care about your soul. In Israel United in Christ we are in the soul-saving business. We are not trying to get in your mind: we want the Bible to get in your mind. We want the laws of God to get in your mind and control you, not the foolishness these preachers and pastors are playing with our people.

“Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.” “Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people.” He is against the pastors who are greedy for money, who break the people’s spirits, who are not teaching. He is going to hold them accountable, and in that day they have a heavy price to pay.

“Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away.” They drive away people who come to learn, people who want to grow, who want to hear the truth and hear about God, because they are talking about sowing a seed of a thousand, a thousand plus a thousand. They live in big houses and drive beautiful cars. When did you ever read of Christ or the apostles, the men teaching the Bible, living in mansions with a stable full of donkeys? It is all lies and brainwashing.

“And have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the Lord.” He will visit them for playing games with people’s heads, getting in their heads and controlling them with lies. The Bible is true; the lies come out of their mouths, and they fill the people up with garbage instead of the truth of the Bible.

sense.text:
“But the word of the Lord was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little.” That is how we are supposed to give out the Bible: precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little.

“That they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.” Fall back, be snared, trapped and taken. Nobody can come against us with this Bible.

Listen to a trinitarian who says Christ on earth was fully God and fully man. Show him the scripture that of that day and hour knoweth no man, not the angels, but the Father only, and ask him whether Christ knew when he would return. He says no. Then how did he not know, if he was fully God? The scriptures say all through that they are different persons: Christ sits on the right hand of God, he was brought before the Ancient of Days. These trinitarians are the dumbest people on earth. You have to know this Bible precept upon precept, line upon line. That is why we have to be studying and meditating, and the Bible always has to be in our mind, or you will say something dumb like him and not be able to back it up.

precepts.why: “For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.” Nobody can fight against precept upon precept, line upon line. Whatever doctrine you come with, you will fall backward and be broken. That is what is going to happen.

sense.text:
This is basic, and we have to have it in our Bible, because they blaspheme the Bible when they say these things. “For verily he took not on him the nature of angels”: he did not take on a heavenly body. “But he took on him the seed of Abraham”: he came through the line of David. So to say he came into the earth and was God and Christ at the same time is to say that everything prophesied in the Bible is not true. He doesn’t believe the Bible. That is what a trinitarian is: a person who doesn’t believe the Bible, and they sound stupid in the end.

One what and three whos: they sound like ‘Who’s on first? What’s on second?’ Confused and lost when you talk to them, not understanding what they say. They are brainwashed and poisoned with the different doctrines they keep coming up with, because Satan transformed himself into an angel of light, and he gets in their mind with this. Then they have the nerve to come to us with those doctrines, and when we shut them down they have no answer, because nobody can gainsay this Bible. The prophets are back on this earth again. We are not getting brainwashed, bamboozled or destroyed. Our mind is strong and rooted in this book, and anybody who comes against us with this book is going to feel the wrath of God, because we speak as the oracles of God.

Our people’s minds are being controlled and they don’t realize it. They are being distracted. People come at you with the flat earth: all right, so what if the earth is flat? Now what? They have nothing behind it. The trinity: all right, God, Christ and the Holy Ghost are the same. Now what? What does that have to do with you keeping the law and commandments? It is all distractions, all witchcraft. They try to put it on us and it doesn’t work, because the Most High already said enchantment does not work against us, and when you come against us with that foolishness you get the wrath of God.

“Her priests have violated my law”: they don’t teach the laws anymore. “And have profaned mine holy things”: everybody has some type of gimmick going on, like the Northern Kingdom, every church with a gimmick to keep the people mesmerized with witchcraft. “They have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean”: they cook pork in the churches, break the sabbath going to the store, eat shrimp, and teach nobody any of God’s laws.

“And have hid their eyes from my sabbaths”: they don’t keep the sabbath. They say Sunday is the sabbath, the first day of the week, worshipping the sun god Ra. “And I am profaned among them”: he is hated among them, the ones who won’t take the real Christ. They never argued about the white image, but as soon as we bring out the black image of Christ they are mad and want to argue. Their brains have been manipulated so that when we show them the truth they don’t want to hear it. They want comfort, lies, to feel good in their so-called truth. We are not playing games with them. We have to be the ones to stand up against these evildoers, with our minds rooted, meditating day and night in this Bible.

“Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls.” That is what they are doing: destroying the people. Some of those people will wake up and come out; a lot of people are leaving the churches fast. This truth is coming out and they have nowhere to hide. We are turning over every rock, and we have them on the run with the word of God, because the prophets are back on the earth again.

It will get to the point where they are so mad they want to kill us. They will lie and throw us in jail. Look at the AI propaganda, making it look like people are somewhere they are not, showing a picture of you doing something you didn’t do. They put it out in the public now to perfect it and get us conditioned to it, and when they roll it out they will lie to the public that we are doing things we aren’t, because the word of God is going out too strong for them. They can’t get us with the scriptures, so the next thing is violence. “To get dishonest gain.”

And hear one of them say Jesus was not a black man but an ethnic Jew, preaching in the dark, with nobody reading the Bible, not even him. The Most High said we are children of light, not children of darkness. He says black people make their race an idol and white people do too, but you hear of white supremacy and white privilege; when did you hear of black supremacy or black privilege? Even a white preacher said our people’s songs come out of the hell we experienced, and that the ones who have a problem with black people had better shut their white mouth, because they are God’s people. But the black preacher has a black body with the white man’s thoughts: mind controlled, manipulated, paid off, a coconut, an Oreo, black outside and white inside. He sold out and talks for the white man.

“And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter.” To daub is to smear a soft substance or plaster, covering something up. Untempered mortar has not been brought to the proper consistency, so it is weak and unstable. That is what these pastors are, men not mixed up well: not teaching the people, not fixing the people, not helping the people, not building their community. That is T.D. Jakes and the rest of them.

“Seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them.” They lie all day. The man said Christ isn’t black: that is a lie. The Bible says he is black, and you never saw that white image in the Bible anywhere. It is a destroyed mind that gets up and says that to the people of God, to the Israelites in that church.

“Saying, Thus saith the Lord God, when the Lord hath not spoken.” They speak that way when he never said it, and they have a heavy price to pay in that day. Their minds are twisted and diluted with money, with poison. They don’t care about the souls of their people; verse 27 already told you they destroy souls. And when we hit them with the scriptures, this is how they look afterwards: clowns.

“Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.” Right now the music industry is destroying the brains of our people. Coming up, you had good music, jazz, music you could play and enjoy. Now you have drill music and trap music, and it is destroying the people. Rappers have a little kid hanging out with them, none of their sons, teaching him evil: gambling, the gangster life, the YN things. They use him as a ploy to lure other young kids into that lifestyle, showing them they can be rappers, gangsters and gamblers.

By the time they are ten, twelve, thirteen they are going to juvenile and to jail, because they have killed somebody, robbed somebody, stabbed somebody, sold drugs, before they are old enough to understand what life is really about. That is why we build up the young men here with workshops teaching them trades: plumbing, mechanics, carpentry, electrician work. We have to pull them away from this, because if we don’t protect the kids, that is where they end up.

precepts.why:
Why do evil communications corrupt good manners? Because you have a clean mind when you are young and growing up, and you look up to people and are influenced by people. So they use this to break the minds of the kids.

“For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders, thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness: all these evil things come from within, and defile the man.” What is heavy about that is that it is everything they were teaching that young man, ten, eleven, maybe twelve years old: all that evil before he even comes of age.

That is mind control: people who manipulate the youth, people who manipulate those coming to serve God and those trying to do right in their lives. There are people out there set up to break them. So we have to have our minds rooted in this Bible, ready to teach our people the right way to live, talk, walk and act: keeping the holy days and getting rid of the holidays, standing on what you believe and not on what feels good. Our people are destroyed from young ages. The little girls act the way they do because that is all they see from the women at home with them.

sense.text:
“Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times”: the latter times we are living in right now, “some shall depart from the faith.” A lot of people will depart from the faith because their mind is being controlled by Satan. Their mind tells them they aren’t good enough, or they committed a sin, and instead of coming in here and getting corrected, fixing themselves up (you might get put out; come back stronger, more fit to be an example), they run back to the world, back to Satan, and Satan tells them, ‘You messed up, it’s over for you.’ Instead of taking whatever judgment they have and coming back better, they run.

“Giving heed to seducing spirits”: giving heed to Satan, “and doctrines of devils.”

“Speaking lies in hypocrisy.” Our people love to hear lies and the hypocrites. “Having their conscience seared with a hot iron.” That is what is happening right now: they argue us down when we tell them to do the right thing, to fix their lives, get off the streets, take care of their household, get married, take care of their kids, live a righteous life. They get mad at us because their conscience is seared with a hot iron. What is the hot iron? Sin.
We are talking about the latter days once again. “This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.” Perilous times, rough hard times, are here right now.

“For men shall be lovers of their own selves.” Social media algorithms were designed to destroy our minds through dopamine addiction, rewiring the brain until people cannot think critically or focus, cannot form real human connections, and become isolated and dependent on approval. That is controlling your mind. You don’t even know how to talk or socialize anymore; you become a lover of yourself, more comfortable by yourself, in your own head all the time. From the music to social media to television to religion, all these things are distractions set up to destroy us: traps of Satan. Social media is set up to destroy you if we don’t use it for the righteous reason. Find things to educate our people with and get off it, instead of scrolling for four, five hours while people call you and you don’t answer.

“Covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy.” That is what is happening to these kids. In Chicago, kids, not adults, beat down a pregnant woman. In Cleveland, nine-year-olds beat down a five-year-old and tried to choke him out. Where is that mindset coming from? They are controlled by Satan, by the TV, by social media, by the games: a plot to destroy this younger generation and control their minds. The adults too, on the dating websites; Satan is pulling them every which way but towards his Bible. That woman was not their parent, but she could have been, and they were still disobedient to her.

“Without natural affection.” Our people don’t have that natural love for one another. We are fragmented, broken people right now. “Trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good.” That is why a lot of people hate us: they see us doing the right thing, feeding the sheep, and they are mad.
“Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God.” That is what is happening now: lovers of pleasure more than lovers of God.

“For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding.” Look at how these kids run around: monsters, with no care about life or anything, a bunch of girls among them. Sottish children means stupid children, with no understanding.

“They are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.” You are looking at our kids, our future. That is why we have to build our future in this truth: get the righteous kids and build them up, homeschool them, and get them away from people like this, or they will turn out the same way.

precepts.why:
“Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good.” Our people have no knowledge, and a soul without knowledge is not good. We should have a knowledge of the Bible, to know how to deal with each other and how to carry ourselves out in public.

“And he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.” He is fast to run to sin: fast to run to hurt somebody, fight somebody, steal, kill, rob.

sense.text: The holidays are another way they control our minds. “Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.” Our people’s minds today are far, far from God. They are not being taught anything; whatever comes on social media is what they are fed.

“Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.” That is what they are doing in the churches, teaching their own commandments: Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, First Ladies’ Day, Christmas, New Year’s, Easter, Good Friday, Thanksgiving. All that garbage is traditions of men, nowhere in the Bible. Those days came out of pagan traditions, taken up by the Roman Catholic Church to convert the pagans.

“For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men.” God said keep Passover. God said keep Tabernacles, keep Hanukkah, keep the Day of Atonement, the blowing of trumpets, the new moons and the sabbath days. But they keep the traditions of men, “as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.”

“Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.” They don’t care about God. Their minds are gone; they have been paid off, they have a little power, and their minds are not in this Bible. None of these pastors is leading our people back to Christ, back to who they are as the Israelites, giving them back their nationality and their King, Christ, and the law and commandments they are supposed to live by: the moral, the dietary, the civil and the ceremonial. They have been pushing the people away from all of it.

“Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.” They have been conditioned and brainwashed to mislead and destroy our people. These are the modern-day Pharisees. But we as the Israelites have to bring our people back: clear the cobwebs out of their minds and get them back on track.
“As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him.”

“Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.” We have to be rooted and built up in Christ, so that our brains won’t be controlled by the outside entities: Satan and the wicked.

“Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit”: through their doctrines and their vain deceit. “After the tradition of men”: following men, following these fake holidays, these religions, the politics, the music, following evil. “After the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.” We have to get everybody back on course to follow Christ, as many as we can: gather the 144 thousand and the mixed multitude, and get their minds back to this Bible. We can’t be caught up in this worldly garbage.

precepts.why:
“God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation”: he chose you to salvation, “through sanctification of the Spirit”: by cleansing your spirit, “and belief of the truth.” “Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.”

“Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught.” The traditions we have been taught are in Leviticus 23. Those are the traditions God taught us: how to keep Passover, Pentecost, Dedication, Tabernacles, all the high holy days. Not the traditions of men, but the traditions God gave, “whether by word, or our epistle.”

“Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.” We have to comfort our minds, and establish ourselves in every good word and every good work of this Bible.

sense.text: The power of prayer. “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you.” Satan desires to have each and every one of us in here who call ourselves repentant. Satan is after every one of us; we are his prey. “That he may sift you as wheat.”

“But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.” That is what we pray: that the Lord is praying for us, so we can get stronger in his truth, walk right in our truth and build our spirits up in his truth.

We already know all this evil is happening in the world. We have to strengthen ourselves through the power of prayer, and the Most High has to lead and direct us back to him. We have to walk in his spirit and live according to this Bible: not just reading it, not just hearing it, but applying it and living it. Your brain has to be filled with the word of God, or Satan will seep his way in and you will find yourself back out in the world.

“Behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?”
“Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.”

“And Elisha prayed, and said, Lord, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see.” See how much power we have with the Lord, our Father: Elisha prayed and he heard him. He opened the young man’s eyes and showed him all the angels and chariots around him: “the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.”

“Elisha prayed unto the Lord, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.” He heard him when he prayed. God hears us when we pray to him, if we keep the law and commandments, walk right in his sight and do what is pleasing to him; then he will get us out of every situation.

“Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?” She couldn’t get pregnant. Elkanah had two wives; his other wife had children, and Hannah couldn’t conceive.
“And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the Lord, and wept sore.” See: she prayed unto the Lord and wept.

She vowed a vow: “if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the Lord all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.”
“Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition.” Go in peace, and God will grant you the petition you have been praying for. God heard her prayers.

“And the Lord remembered her.” That is what we all want: for the Lord to remember us, and to hear our prayers when we pray. If you are playing games in here, he is not hearing your prayers. If you are not living the way you are supposed to, if you are in sin, plainly, he is not hearing your prayers.

“She bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of the Lord.” She asked for a man child and vowed no razor would come upon his head, and the Lord heard her and gave her a man child. That is the power of prayer. We have to be praying, and believing that it can happen.
“There was a certain man in Cesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band.”
“A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house.” Feared God with all his house. “Which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.”

“Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.” A memorial: God remembered the good work he was doing. His prayers reached up to heaven, and so did the alms he gave, because he did it sincerely. He wasn’t penny pinching, wasn’t squeezing a penny. What Bible have we been reading? Why are we playing games in his truth?

precepts.why: People say Cornelius was Italian, a Roman, not an Israelite. Paul “found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy”: a Jew who came from Italy. “Because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome.” He made them depart from Rome, which means they were living in Rome. The Israelites were living in Italy, so an Italian band could have an Israelite in it.

sense.text: “Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.” The Bishop brought out a while ago that we need to be praying at least three times a day, because we all have something we are battling.

“He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me.” He was talking about a physical battle; we have trials and tribulations, and we battle all the time. To overcome them we have to be praying, fasting, and anointing ourselves in this truth.

precepts.why:
Three times a day: let’s see what Daniel was doing. “His windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem.” Toward Jerusalem. We say we have to pray to the east, but if you are somewhere else, say in Chile, you face northeast: toward Jerusalem. Not just to the east: we pray toward our homeland, wherever we are.

“He kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.” “Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God,” and went before the king concerning the king’s decree against asking a petition of any God or man within thirty days. Daniel prayed to God regardless, with his windows open, three times a day like we are supposed to. And the Lord was with Daniel at all times, through both captivities, the Babylonian captivity among them.

sense.text: “And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison.” They beat Paul and Silas and threw them in prison, “and made their feet fast in the stocks.”
“And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.”

“And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one’s bands were loosed.” Not a little earthquake: a great earthquake, when they prayed. When I pray, I want to feel that: an earthquake, knowing the Lord hears my prayers.

“We may speak much, and yet come short.” We can’t pray to him enough for everything he created, everything he gives us. We could pray a million times a day and it would not be enough for all he does for us.
“How shall we be able to magnify him? for he is great above all his works.”

“When ye glorify the Lord, exalt him as much as ye can.” When we pray, we have to exalt him as much as we can. “And when ye exalt him, put forth all your strength.” We have to put forth all our strength when we pray, and be sincere. Cry to him and tell him the truth. Not ‘Oh God, can you help me get a car,’ ‘Oh God, just protect me’: have serious, real prayers. God, I’m struggling. I’m fighting, Lord, to stand in this truth, to keep my head up, to do what’s right. I want to please you, Lord. I’m falling weak. I need wisdom, knowledge and understanding. I need faith; my faith is running low. “And be not weary; for ye can never go far enough.”
“Who hath seen him, that he might tell us? and who can magnify him as he is?” Nobody can magnify him as he is.

“Men ought always to pray, and not to faint.” We have to always pray and not faint, and put forth all our strength. There is power in prayer. All through the Bible he heard the prophets when they prayed.
“And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.”

“Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.” She kept praying to him, kept troubling him, for vengeance on her adversary. That is what we have to do with the Lord when we are going through it: pray and pray and weary him. Let him know: Lord, we are going through it, we need your help, we can’t do it without you.
One of the best prayers in the Bible. “Sing unto the Lord a new song”: let us sing unto the Lord a new song when we pray, “and his praise in the congregation of saints.”
“Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.” Rejoice in the black Messiah.

“For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people.” God loves us and hears us. When you keep the law and commandments and walk right in his sight, he takes pleasure in you and loves you. “He will beautify the meek with salvation.”

“Let the high praises of God be in their mouth”: the high praises, the prayers, in our mouth. “And a twoedged sword in their hand.” This Bible is the two-edged sword right now, but then there will be a two-edged sword from the heavenly Father.
“To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people.” In that time we will execute vengeance upon all the heathen that did us wrong.
“To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron.” Nobody is getting away. Not one of them.

“To execute upon them the judgment written.” That is what we are praying for: the judgment that is written against them. “This honour have all his saints.” Make sure you are saying this in your prayers. We have to weary him with this prayer before we can get out of here, so we can gather together the 144 thousand.
